title: Euromonitor identifies five consumer trends set to shape 2027
summary: Trust, transparency, reliability and tangible benefits are becoming increasingly important as consumers reassess their relationships with brands. Euromonitor International's latest report highlights five behavioural shifts with implications for the beauty industry. title: Solabia steps up its transformation with the acquisition of Ethical Naturals
summary: The specialist in natural and biotechnological active ingredients is pursuing its strategic refocusing on cosmetics and nutraceuticals. Solabia plans to divest its microbiological diagnostics division while acquiring a majority stake in US-based Ethical Naturals Inc. Solabia is sharpening its strategic focus on cosmetics, nutrition, and life sciences.
